concepts.title: Finite-rank linear operator
concepts.description: A linear map whose image is finite-dimensional.

concepts.title: Finner’s inequality
concepts.description: If nonnegative Y_e are hypergraph-correlated over a finite hypergraph and φ is a fractional matching with positive weights on the factors considered, then E∏_eY_e≤∏_e(EY_e^{1/φ(e)})^{φ(e)}. Zero-weight factors can instead be controlled by their essential suprema.

concepts.title: First Dirichlet spectral gap
concepts.description: For a bounded-domain self-adjoint Dirichlet operator with ordered eigenvalues λ₁<λ₂≤⋯, the first spectral gap is λ₂−λ₁.

concepts.title: Fisher–Kolmogorov–Petrovsky–Piskunov equation
concepts.description: A reaction–diffusion equation ∂_tu=DΔu+r u(1−u), with D,r>0, on a specified spatial domain and with specified initial and boundary conditions. It appears in population models and branching Brownian survival probabilities.

concepts.title: Flandoli–Gess–Scheutzow synchronization criterion for ordered random systems
concepts.description: Let a continuous order-preserving random dynamical system on a Polish space have closed partial order and one-point laws converging to μ from every initial state. If for every ε>0 there are f≤g with μ([f,g])≥1−ε, then there is a past-measurable invariant random point attracting every deterministic initial point in pullback probability. No normality, admissibility or white-noise assumption is required.

concepts.title: Flandoli–Gess–Scheutzow weak synchronization for stochastic porous media
concepts.description: On a bounded smooth domain in ℝᵈ with d≤4, the zero-Dirichlet stochastic porous medium equation dX=[Δ(|X|^{m−1}X)+X]dt+dW, m>1, with trace-class additive Wiener noise has a singleton weak point attractor whenever its associated random dynamical system has one-point laws converging to one limiting law from every H⁻¹ initial state. The point also attracts deterministic sets contained in order intervals for the usual positive-distribution order.

concepts.title: Fractional Brownian motion
concepts.description: A centered continuous Gaussian process Bᴴ_t with covariance ½(|t|²ᴴ+|s|²ᴴ−|t−s|²ᴴ), H∈(0,1), normalized to start at zero. It has stationary increments, generally dependent unless H=½.

concepts.title: Fractional chromatic number of a graph
concepts.description: For a finite graph G, χ_f(G)=inf_{b≥1}χ_b(G)/b, where χ_b is its b-fold chromatic number.

concepts.title: Fractional matching in a finite hypergraph
concepts.description: Weights φ(e)≥0 on the hyperedges such that ∑_{e∋v}φ(e)≤1 for every vertex v. The fractional matching number is the maximum of ∑_eφ(e).

concepts.title: Fractional-matching bound for random independent sets in a hypergraph
concepts.description: Include each vertex v of a finite hypergraph independently with probability p_v. For every fractional matching φ, the probability that the chosen vertices contain no hyperedge is at most ∏_e(1−∏_{v∈e}p_v)^{φ(e)}. For k-uniform hypergraphs and constant p this is at most (1−pᵏ)^{ν*(H)}.

concepts.title: Function of bounded variation on an interval
concepts.description: A real function f has bounded variation on [a,b] if sup∑_i|f(t_i)−f(t_{i−1})| over finite ordered partitions is finite. Vector-valued paths use the corresponding norm.

concepts.title: Fundamental theorem of Lebesgue integration
concepts.description: If g∈L¹([a,b]), F(x)=∫_a^xg is absolutely continuous and F′=g almost everywhere. Conversely every absolutely continuous F has an integrable a.e. derivative and F(x)−F(a)=∫_a^xF′.

concepts.title: Galton–Watson branching process
concepts.description: A population process Z_{n+1}=∑_{i=1}^{Z_n}A_{n,i}, where all offspring counts are independent with a common nonnegative-integer distribution and are independent of the past.

concepts.title: Even moments of a centered Gaussian
concepts.description: For Z∼N(0,σ²), E[Z^{2k}]=(2k−1)!!σ^{2k} and odd moments vanish, with (−1)!!=1. The double factorial counts pairings of 2k labeled elements.

concepts.title: Orthogonal invariance of the standard Gaussian distribution
concepts.description: If X has n independent N(0,1) coordinates and U is a real orthogonal n×n matrix, then UX has the same distribution as X.

concepts.title: Gaussian process
concepts.description: A real or vector-valued stochastic process whose every finite vector of coordinate evaluations has a multivariate normal law.

concepts.title: Gelfand triple of Banach and Hilbert spaces
concepts.description: A reflexive real Banach space V embedded continuously and densely in a real Hilbert space H, with H identified with its continuous dual so that V⊂H⊂V*. The duality V*×V extends the H inner product.

concepts.title: Generalized eigenvector
concepts.description: For an endomorphism T and scalar λ, a nonzero vector v with (T−λI)ᵏv=0 for some k≥1 is a generalized eigenvector; a Jordan chain satisfies (T−λI)v₁=0 and (T−λI)v_{j+1}=v_j.
